subject.title: [Feature]: WebUI notification system, cron job management popups, and context monitor integration

question: Should OpenClaw add a core connected-Control-UI in-app notification/action queue for cron results and context pressure, and which related action surfaces should share that contract?
rationale: Current main has partial cron, Web Push, and context-monitoring surfaces, but the remaining work changes Control UI product architecture and overlaps several open notification/action issues rather than being a narrow repair.

options.title: Scope Core Notification Queue First
options.body: Define one connected-Control-UI notification/action contract, then add cron-finished and context-pressure integrations as focused follow-up work.

options.title: Make A Related Action Surface Canonical
options.body: Move the shared notification/action API decision to a narrower related tracker and keep this issue as UX requirements for that contract.

options.title: Defer In-App Toasts
options.body: Keep the current inline cron, Web Push, and context-ring surfaces and revisit this only if maintainers later sponsor a core toast/snooze layer.

recommendation.title: Scope Core Notification Queue First
recommendation.body: Define one connected-Control-UI notification/action contract, then add cron-finished and context-pressure integrations as focused follow-up work.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has prior review context on this issue and recent history in cron notification routing and product-boundary decisions for related surfaces.
